overview: This enum groups characters for story sequencer voice lines that use shared team appearances.

None.technical: uint8 value 0 and the Character row constructor default. IsTeamSharingPairGroup accepts any value other than Independent. A team of at least two characters with None therefore passes the paired voice condition. Seventeen exported character rows use it.

JujutsuSorcerers.simple: The character belongs to the sorcerer pair group.
JujutsuSorcerers.technical: uint8 value 1. When every teammate has this group and the team has at least two members, IsTeamSharingPairGroup returns true. Sequencer appearance voices then use the ally group set or the APPEARANCE_02 voice id. Twenty exported character rows use it.

CursedSpirits.simple: The character belongs to the cursed spirit pair group.
CursedSpirits.technical: uint8 value 2. An all-cursed-spirit team of at least two characters passes IsTeamSharingPairGroup. The sequencer then selects the ally group voice set or the APPEARANCE_02 voice id. Five exported character rows use it.

CursedWombDeathPaintings.simple: The character belongs to the cursed womb death painting pair group.
CursedWombDeathPaintings.technical: uint8 value 3. A team of at least two characters that all have this group passes IsTeamSharingPairGroup. The sequencer then uses the ally group voice set or the APPEARANCE_02 voice id. Two exported character rows use it.

Independent.simple: The character is left out of paired voice groups.
Independent.technical: uint8 value 4. IsTeamSharingPairGroup returns false as soon as the target character has this group. Sequencer appearance voices stay on the standard group set or APPEARANCE_01. Four exported character rows use it.

Invalid.technical: uint8 value 255. No exported row uses it and no branch names it. The team check would treat it like any other non-Independent value if it were present.

notes: The team check compares group values only for exact equality. It has one special case for Independent.
The group affects story sequencer voice selection when the team has at least two characters.
Supplied Character exports contain 20 JujutsuSorcerers rows, 17 None rows, 5 CursedSpirits rows, 4 Independent rows and 2 CursedWombDeathPaintings rows.
No Invalid row appears in the supplied exports.
